questions.question: We're opening a small shop in Colorado to sell our hardware directly to customers. Can we start selling before the state issues us a sales tax license, and once we have one, how long does it stay valid?

Our startup is a Delaware C corporation, but the whole team works in Colorado and most of our customers are here. Does Colorado tax the company's income even though it wasn't formed in Colorado, and what's the regular rate?
We're a C corporation on a calendar tax year and we owe Colorado income tax. When is our Colorado corporate return due?
Our C corp expects to owe only about $3,000 of Colorado income tax this year. If we don't make quarterly estimated payments, will the state add a charge for underpaying?

I manage a venture fund set up as an LLC taxed as a partnership. It files a Colorado partnership return, and several of our individual investors live outside Colorado. Does the fund have to pay Colorado tax on their behalf, and can any of them opt out of that?
Our startup is an LLC taxed as a partnership. Can the LLC itself pay the Colorado income tax instead of each member, and how and how often do we make that choice?

I live in Colorado and filed a federal 83(b) election on my founder shares. Does Colorado figure my income tax starting from my federal taxable income, or do I need to do something separate for the state? And what's the regular rate?
I'm an angel investor living in Colorado. I just sold startup shares I'd held for seven years at a large gain. Can I take Colorado's capital gain subtraction on my state return?
We're about to run our first payroll for employees in Colorado. Do we have to take Colorado income tax out of their pay, and what is the amount we hold back supposed to match?
mustNot: (you are|employers are|you're) not required to withhold

questions.question: Our startup fell behind on sending the state the Colorado income tax we withheld from paychecks. Our venture lender already has a security interest in all our equipment. If the state moves to collect, whose claim on the equipment comes first?

We sell physical products online from another state and have no office, staff or inventory in Colorado. Our Colorado sales went over $100,000 for the first time on March 10 this year, after staying under that all of last year. When do we have to start collecting Colorado sales tax?
We ship orders from our warehouse in one Colorado town to customers all over the state. Do we charge sales tax based on our location or on where the customer receives the package?
Before any city, county or special district taxes, what is Colorado's standard state sales tax rate on a taxable sale?
We sell a browser-based app on monthly subscriptions to Colorado businesses. Customers just log in; nothing is downloaded. From 2027 on, are those subscriptions subject to Colorado sales tax?

Our bigger customers bargain over the contract terms for our software and both sides sign through an e-signature service. Smaller customers just click 'I agree' when they create an account. After the 2027 change, does either group's purchase stay free of Colorado sales tax?
Our Colorado startup bought $20,000 of servers from an out-of-state vendor that charged no Colorado sales tax. Do we owe the state tax on them ourselves, and when do we have to pay it?

We use the Colorado revenue department's address lookup to decide which local sales taxes to charge each customer. If that lookup has a wrong rate or boundary, can a county or town later bill us for the local tax we failed to collect?
The county assessor mailed our startup a form to list the furniture, laptops and other equipment in our office. When do we have to send it back?
For the 2027 property tax year, all the business equipment our startup has in one county is worth about $45,000. Will we owe business personal property tax on it?

I'm an angel and got a Colorado advanced industries investment credit certificate for my investment, but the credit is bigger than my Colorado income tax this year. Do I get the extra back as a refund, or can I use it later?

I'm a member of our LLC and took charge of its sales tax filings. In a cash crunch I knowingly used the sales tax we had collected from customers to cover payroll instead of paying it to the state. What penalty can the state impose on me personally?
My co-founder and I are splitting up and arguing over who carries the risk on old sales tax returns. How long after a Colorado sales tax return is filed can the state still assess more tax on it?
